translations.web: Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent of her works.
translations.bsb: Behold, I will cast her onto a bed of sickness, and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless they repent of her deeds.
